menu.name: Single shot
menu.description: One clean block. Long enough to finish a thought, short enough to start now.

menu.name: Long black
menu.description: For work that takes a while to warm up — writing, reading, anything with a shape.

menu.name: Pot of tea
menu.description: The slow one. Settle in, no clock-watching.

menu.name: Just a glass of water
menu.description: A small, honest attempt. Five minutes is still five minutes.

houseRules: Phone face down, on the other side of the table.
When the timer ends, actually get up.
Coming back after a bad session counts as a session.
nowPlaying: Rain on a window, a milk steamer somewhere behind you, and the low hum of other people working.
